fields.herb: must resolve in tcm.db name_cn/alias, or start with 'formula:'
fields.template: condition template name used by the engine
fields.solvent: free text, prefer engine vocabulary (water, ethanol, ...)
fields.temp_C: number, 25 for room temperature, empty only if unknown (note it)
fields.compound_id: InChIKey preferred; SMILES if inchikey unavailable

notes: name_only rows can be used for context but never count as an engine hit.
A literature row needs herb+template+solvent+temp+time to enter the condition layer.
Rows from one DOI must stay in the same train/holdout split.
